def clean_and_round_value(value):
    # Do not alter blank cells or formulas
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, str):
        if value.startswith('='):
            return value
        # Remove non-breaking spaces, clean common non-printing chars, and trim regular spaces
        s = value.replace('\xa0', '').replace(chr(160), '')
        s = ''.join(ch for ch in s if (ord(ch) >= 32 or ch in '\t\n\r'))
        s = s.strip()
        # Remove embedded regular spaces as the macro was intended to remove spaces
        s = s.replace(' ', '')
        if s == '':
            return ''
        # If the cleaned text is numeric, round to remove decimals and store as a number
        try:
            d = Decimal(s.replace(',', ''))
            return int(d.quantize(Decimal('1'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
        except Exception:
            return s
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool):
        if isinstance(value, float) and math.isnan(value):
            return None
        return int(Decimal(str(value)).quantize(Decimal('1'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
    return value

for row in range(1, 4):
    cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=3)
    cell.value = clean_and_round_value(cell.value)

wb.save(output_path)
